inputPricePerMillionMicros.description: Price per million INPUT tokens, in micro-USD.

outputPricePerMillionMicros.description: Price per million OUTPUT tokens, in micro-USD.

supportsToolCalling.description: NATIVE tool calling. Without this the model is chat-only and cannot be bound to an agent (RN-040).

supportsVision.description: Accepts IMAGE input. `false` means the provider did not declare the modality — not that the model can't do it (ADR 0041).

supportsReasoning.description: Accepts explicit reasoning (thinking). On OpenRouter it comes from `supported_parameters: reasoning`.

generatesImage.description: PRODUCES image — an axis different from accepting it as input. Few models have it, and confusing the two sends the user to the wrong model.

manualPricing.description: Price typed in from the provider's docs, not synced. The price sync does not overwrite a row marked without an explicit decision.

availability.description: REMOTE reality observed by sync, an axis independent from curation. `unavailable` is a model that vanished from the provider catalog — it is never deleted, because bindings and cost history point to it.

lastSeenAt.description: Last time sync saw the model in the provider catalog.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
